oneOf.description: The launcher's own declared language metadata — Steam's `supported_languages`, an `AppxManifest` resource list, and their kin.

A compiled localization resource the engine ships: an Unreal `.locres` under a culture directory, a Unity string table carrying a locale code. The strongest of the three, because it is the game's own files rather than a store listing somebody may have forgotten to update.
